card.name: Linking words before ranges and limits
card.fires_on: Small linking words like 'to' or 'of' right before a number of years, such as 'up to eight years' or '4 Years to Less Than 12'. Also fires on a few other connecting spots in education, age and treatment-line text.

modes.label: Year ranges and limits
modes.description: 'to' or 'of' linking a span of years or ages, just before the upper number.
modes.example: Some medical specialties require up<< to>> eight years working as a resident.

modes.label: Age-range 'to'
modes.description: 'to' between two ages in pediatric dosing headings.
modes.example: OXBRYTA Recommended Dosage for Pediatric Patients 4 Years<< to>> Less Than 12 Years When Used

modes.label: First-line headings
modes.example: 2.1 Recommended Dosing<< First>>-Line Advanced RCC INLYTA
